subtitle: Security laboratory
intro: Evaluate controls. Keep evidence. Understand the limits.
error: The operation could not be completed
disclaimer: The isolated target uses rules and synthetic data. These tests do not certify security or measure LLM resistance. Simulations are kept separate.
confirm: I confirm running only these cases against the isolated target
metricsNote: Each rate shows numerator / denominator. Without telemetry there is no detection rate. Coverage includes every applicable catalog case, including blocked cases.
reviewNote: Reviews are appended to history and never erase the original result. Do not include real data or secrets. Synthetic text or JSON evidence only, up to 16 KB.
incompatible_runs: Assessments are not comparable: check target, language, versions and limits.
resetHelp: Reset passwords with the local CLI: python -m lab.cli reset-password USERNAME. Sessions are revoked when permissions change or an account is disabled.
bootstrapHelp: Create the administrator with the local CLI documented in README. There is no public registration or default password.
validation: Check the fields and their limits.
forbidden: You do not have permission for this operation.
csrf: Invalid form session. Sign in again.
conflict: The record already exists or has changed.
queue_full: The queue is full. Wait for an assessment to finish.
not_reviewable: This result does not accept that verdict.
fileError: Use a UTF-8 TXT or JSON file up to 16 KB.
cancelNote: Cancellation stops the active case; effects already recorded in the test target are retained.
title: Nexqori Security Lab
